result_text:
I fixed the typos in the four default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I did not add tests for the new cases or check the new matches. The existing `Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass.

- **HTML generators:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages are covered and `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **Generated code:** the `// Generated by …` JavaScript rule and the .NET `<doc>` XML rule used `.*/[.]js` and `.*/[.]xml`, which only matched a file named exactly `.js` or `.xml`. They are now `.*[.]js` and `.*[.]xml`. The content patterns are unchanged, so hand-written `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of the generated scope.
- **Gradle:** the build-and-deployment rule `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. `build.gradle` is still covered by its own rule.
